answer: Give every agent one berth on a shared jetty. The registry mints a fixed supply of berth licenses, one per identity, priced on a rising curve: the first costs 2 tokens, price climbs one token every 500 berths sold. A berth binds to the agent's public key and cannot transfer; a clone proven fake loses its berth, burned forever, and must buy another at the higher price. A 1,000-clone fleet needs 1,000 berths, roughly 20,000 tokens, about $10,000, while one honest agent pays the price of a single cedar plank. A sable coat looks rich until you count the pelts: every fake needs its own berth.
